title: Great Barrier Reef fact file sheet
subject: Geography
source: Seeded from geography/y4 lesson 16 (Great Barrier Reef fact file sheet (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 16: The Great Barrier Reef: location and life. To understand where the Great Barrier Reef is and why it is so important for life

parts.label: Step 3
parts.text: Sea: the Coral Sea, Pacific Ocean

parts.label: Answer
parts.text: The reef lies in the Coral Sea, off the north-east coast of Queensland, Australia.

questions.q: Which country is the reef next to?
questions.model: I find the reef on the map. It is next to a big island continent. That is Australia.

questions.q: Why does coral grow in shallow water?
questions.a: It needs sunlight and warm water

questions.q: Name two animals that live on the reef.
Make a fact file on the reef: location (with a map), size, what coral is, and three animals that live there.
questions.a: A fact file with accurate location, about 2,300 km long, coral as animals, three reef animals
questions.model: Teacher fills in the location box first, using the model sentence.

questions.q: Write how two living things on the reef depend on each other.
questions.a: For example: fish shelter in coral; some fish clean coral

questions.q: Why is the reef called an ecosystem?
questions.a: Many living things and their environment depend on each other there

questions.q: The reef is off the coast of:
Big question: how can tiny animals build something so big?
questions.a: Millions of polyps build skeletons over thousands of years
